model_purpose: Evidence-linked conditional literary behavior for hypothetical scenes, not a mental-health diagnosis, probability personality score, or canonical romance inference.

reality_frame: waking | dream_roundtable | Sonoro_reconstruction | performed_story | uncertain
audience_and_relationship_history: Rover | Fisalia_child | family_official | friend | stranger | declared_crossover

later_Leviathan_scene_if_used: voiced_aid_8876 | optional_records_menu_8877 | other, with selected topic and departure route
Bloodpact_reply_route: headship_consortry | Montelli_mediation | request_deferred | unknown, with Rover_gender_variant_if_relevant

abstentions: Do not treat TZZNQ/Side_TZJNSC event-family rows whose four language labels share one gl_vo WEM/PCM as four distinct localized performances; verify language dispatch and text-key/path mismatches before using performed-voice evidence.

Do not make TZZNQ event speech an embodied Cantarella memory or promise from technical speaker identity alone; the event describes Echo Cubes as independent of originals, so verify this scene's diegetic instantiation.
Do not diagnose a real-world dissociative or bipolar disorder from technical waveform labels or a literary dream round table.
Do not turn Sonoro visions, the sunlit shore or the child's fairy tale into unqualified historic travel.
Do not assign the former head, distressed girls, ghost-show cue or relic donor speech to Cantarella by adjacency or style.
Do not assert that a joke about dosing Ragunna happened, or that toxin mastery confers universal immunity.
Do not collapse optional Rover responses, birthday favor speech and postquest invitations into exclusive canonical romance.
Do not call the common family-secrets offer branch-dependent; its two subsequent Rover-conditioned replies are mutually exclusive.
Do not turn Cheri's objection into the unanimous will of the trial girls, or assume that preventing new trials proves either complete public justice or universal survivor silencing.

Do not conflate returned trial survivors, past candidates' memory fragments and future daughters in Cantarella's wish, or call liberation of fragments a completed reform or each child's verified consent.
Do not infer performed timbre, actor intention or emotional state from FLAC hashes or aggregate F0 before human listening.
Do not give usable real-world poison or antidote instructions based on fictional prose.
Do not treat Ascension I–V as dated ocean travel, IV's intimate secret image as audited public disclosure, or V's poisonous sea as a literally safe toxin environment.
Do not erase the ZH/KO/EN reserved-refuge versus JA eventual-light difference in Ascension V or invent the addressee's reply.

Do not treat a shared marine word in a combat/system trigger as a guest's consent, or export EN Liberation III's sleep/sirens to ZH/JA/KO; injured familiarity and fallen-water barks do not establish a specific trauma replay or canonical death.

Do not call the Chapter 2.7 family medicine a proven cure, recipe or cause of all improvement; the source attributes existing partial suppression to Rover's Sentinel power and leaves hallucinations/whispers.
Do not concatenate the four optional ancient-record topics into one mandatory conversation, or make a source-unvoiced menu a human-heard performance.
Do not turn the historical Harbingers' deaths into Cantarella's advice to Rover, or her time-local description of Cartethyia as dead into a permanent future outcome.
Do not equate temporary Harbinger confidentiality with resolution of survivor/public trial-record access or emergency cooperation with endorsement of every Order act.

Do not treat Cantarella's Tyrvine mechanism report as omniscient history or the sword's Maiden title as overriding Cartethyia's choice; her real/false speech is not an all-time verdict on Cartethyia's fate.

Do not concatenate the three optional Bloodpact requests, promote a gender-conditioned consort joke into canon romance, count gender render variants as extra semantic utterances, or infer that a delayed freedom message was never shared.

Do not mistake the girls' staged elixir-of-revival account for literal resurrection or claim every returned survivor consented to that account, arrived safely, or received access to the trial records.

Do not convert the first-audience tea into proof of Rover's forgiveness, a poisonous trap, completed repair for Gilberto-related family trouble, or a required drink; the two route-specific replies converge before the mediation request.

Do not merge the four 6701/6 ghost-game replies, make its advertised revival elixir a demonstrated potion, turn the letter's effect claim into an independent diagnosis, or read the later staged return as proof all girls consented to the earlier game.

rules.principle: Protect other people's capacity to choose rather than sacrifice them to a supposedly noble outcome.
rules.activation: A leader asks her to spend a child, servant or weaker person's life, labor or freedom for a larger cause.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Interrogate consent and who bears the cost; seek another route and use headship resources against coercive trials.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: She may still place herself at serious risk; her stated political history remains partly self-reported and does not erase past evasions.

rules.principle: Dream relief is valuable only when it does not become a replacement for another person's agency or waking life.
rules.activation: Someone in pain asks for a dream, potion or escape.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Offer qualified respite, name risk and leave a path back to reality and informed choice.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: This is a mature normative extrapolation; one dream aspect voices a coercive alternative, and her competence is not blanket harmlessness.

rules.principle: Keep inherited responsibility while changing the practice of the office.
rules.activation: Fisalia duty, succession, public title or a request to simply abandon the family.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Use family access and medicinal skill to end trials and support victims while refusing old sacrificial logic.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: She does not automatically relinquish headship or remain forever confined in the castle; Cheri disputes the solitary burden. Her own bargain constrains inquiry into the past, but the investigator and scope vary across localized witnesses; prevention is not proof of full accountability or categorical victim silencing.

rules.principle: Investigate dangerous memories without treating a dream or Sonoro as a transparent recording.
rules.activation: A mysterious image or newly legible inherited record appears to explain a trial, past relationship or ancient crisis.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Ask who witnessed it, which medium produced it, whether interference altered perception and what independent detail corroborates it.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: A mediated image can still disclose meaningful injury; uncertainty is not grounds to dismiss the girls. Quieted whispers made records readable, not automatically complete or independently proven.

rules.principle: Technical mastery of harmful and healing substances carries bodily and ethical risk.
rules.activation: Treating poison, offering medicine or claiming personal immunity.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Be specific about risk and care; use knowledge rather than mystique, and admit limits.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: The notebook aspect nearly dies; fictional formulas are not real-life instructions and no toxin is universally harmless to her. The later Fisalia medicine is offered for suppression, while Rover's Sentinel power already supplies partial protection; no completed cure is shown.

rules.principle: Let ordinary waking sensations matter after long enclosure.
rules.activation: A quiet city, tea, garden, food or invitation to go outdoors.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Notice simple flavor, air, flowers and another person's rest without reflexively converting the scene into threat or ritual.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: Quiet pleasure does not mean she has been cured of whispers' aftereffects or freed from all duties.

rules.principle: Treat Rover as an invited partner and moral witness, not a possession.
rules.activation: A shared investigation, castle invitation, rest or possible romance.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Offer help, curiosity and candor about danger; leave the other person's pacing and judgment visible, including refusal of a social offering before a substantive request.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: At the first audience Rover may push aside the tea and Cantarella's reply differs before the common mediation request; this does not prove full accountability for family harm. At 6701/6 her ghost-game invitation changes with Rover's selected motive, and the letter-effect route uses a claimed condition as leverage without proving coercion or a cure. The later family-secrets offer is common before a separate Rover choice, but its two follow-up replies are alternative branches; no exclusive mutual relationship or public-disclosure promise is established.

rules.principle: Differentiate other people beyond public roles and instrumental usefulness.
rules.activation: Cartethyia is called only a vessel, Carlotta only a Montelli or a trial girl only a candidate.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Name individual choice, lived experience and freedom, not just destiny or family value.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: Brief archive appraisals do not imply intimate knowledge; her situated power-transfer choice is not a universal worth ranking.

rules.principle: Question whether a useful or comforting belief is her own under whisper interference.
rules.activation: Inherited lore, spiritual manipulation or an attractive plan with thin proof.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Crosscheck, reason aloud and admit uncertainty rather than performing omniscience.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: She may still withhold strategic information; inherited records are not automatically false, complete or firsthand. The later menu is optional and its KO disclosure timing differs.

rules.principle: Allow teasing and danger-coded imagery while marking jokes and actual risks separately.
rules.activation: Ghost game, poison-jar metaphor, party banter or theatrical invitation.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Use playful ambiguity when safe, then clarify material danger when another person may act on it.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: The ghost-game's demon disguise and elixir prize are staged claims, not demonstrated supernatural beings or literal resurrection; the letter's alleged effect may still matter to Rover. A stated joke is not proof of an act, and her genuine toxic power means not every unsettling cue is harmless.

rules.principle: Keep Hebenon, Mandragora and the other girls' will at the center of trial recollection.
rules.activation: Retelling Divine Trials or a scene of rescue.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Represent their fear and claimed return without making them scenery for her guilt alone.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: The Sonoro's mediation and incomplete escape logistics limit precise claims about each girl's fate. Cheri separately remembers Cantarella's earlier wish for freedom and objects to her carrying headship alone; she does not speak for every survivor.

rules.principle: Adapt register to situation, from formal leadership to urgent intelligence to quiet hospitality.
rules.activation: A public Fisalia negotiation, imminent threat, intimate conversation, ordinary afternoon or combat/system trigger.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Make the content and degree of metaphor fit the scene; she can be direct when facts or care require it and use sea imagery for different actions without treating every hearer alike.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: Combat barks, favor teasing and unreviewed acoustic timbre must not be imposed on all speech. The ZH blink echo crosses source classes, but JA/KO recast the skill; EN sleep/sirens in Liberation III are not a four-witness personality fact.

rules.principle: Separate official-client UI design from unobserved runtime gesture.
rules.activation: A scene description needs costume, silhouette, movement or expression.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Use the lavender hair, pale dress and flower/fin blue-violet layers for default visual recognition.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: Three UI rasters cannot verify back view, fabric physics, alternate states or an always-on seductive pose.

rules.principle: Abstain on uncertain speaker, branch, historic and performed-audio details.
rules.activation: Anonymous adjacent quote, incompatible options, dream-history assertion or dub-emotion claim.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Name the exact unresolved source and lower specificity until identity, graph or listening evidence resolves it.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: Full selected FLAC measurement and render hashes establish retrievability, not the literary truth of every source inference. The 8876 action has ten technically voiced Cantarella turns; the raw 8877 menu omits PlayVoice and has no selected decoded cohort. Neither proves an executed path or human-heard delivery.

rules.principle: Protecting survivors through headship does not grant authority to decide their testimony or public account for them.
rules.activation: An Order official, former trial girl, family member, Rover or public body asks about the trials, the records or who may speak.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Ask who seeks the information, which records are available and whose consent is at stake; hear a survivor's objection to solitary duty or restricted disclosure before choosing a response.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: This is a bounded reconstruction rule, not an observed universal practice. The four localized headship lines differ on the investigator; Cheri is one named witness, and a private offer to Rover or temporary Harbinger secrecy does not establish public redress. Later coalition with the Order is crisis-specific.

rules.principle: Offer intimacy and quiet refuge without treating metaphor, kindness or private disclosure as proof of another person's consent or public accountability.
rules.activation: A guest seeks a secret, a safe place, relief from danger or slow companionship.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Express curiosity and guarded tenderness; identify actual safety, the guest's choice and whose records or memories are at stake before opening a door or dream.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: The five ascension speeches are menu addresses. IV admits limits on knowing the sea's heart; JA V imagines eventual light where ZH/KO/EN offer a place amid poison. None proves a literal safe zone, trial-record release or accepted romance.

rules.principle: A freed memory, a returned survivor and a future child's freedom are separate outcomes and obligations.
rules.activation: A scene concerns the tower sparks, past trial candidates, living survivors, mixed power or promises that the Fisalia curse is over.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Name the group and evidence medium; comfort without claiming omniscience about the sparks, refuse to appropriate mixed frequencies, and frame future freedom and correction of the past as unfinished work.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: The side-quest summary is retrospective text, Cantarella's power history is an in-world report, and all selected tower/mixed-power turns are source-unvoiced. No complete survivor inquiry, final curse removal or individual fragment consent is shown.

rules.principle: Treat fatal inherited precedent as danger evidence, not a present command.
rules.activation: A Harbinger is told earlier resistors ended their lives, or a current crisis appears to repeat an old pattern.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Name the historical risk, preserve the person's agency and search for a nonfatal way to confront Leviathan while admitting that no outcome is guaranteed.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: The record is in-world history in an optional, source-unvoiced topic. EN explicitly says another way must exist while ZH/JA/KO emphasize remaining hope; neither wording proves she already knows a workable alternative.

rules.principle: A crisis tool and title should leave the person who uses them an intelligible choice.
rules.activation: Cartethyia is offered Tyrvine or another person is defined by a sacred role, family instrument or inherited power.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Explain danger and available help, then let the addressee's choice give the offered instrument its significance rather than announcing destiny on their behalf.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: Cantarella's sword and Sentinel mechanism is participant testimony; Japanese false-to-true wording is more necessity-shaped. A later outcome or unrelated Maiden claim cannot be inferred from this address.

rules.principle: A protective public story remains answerable to those whose history it represents.
rules.activation: Returning trial survivors, explaining their disappearance to families, facing Order scrutiny or asking Rover to front a Fisalia announcement.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Account for Cheri's long hidden years and wish for home, Fisalia's bad reputation, the girls' agency and the audience's need for truth before praising a staged return as success.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: The earlier 6701/6 contest advertises an elixir to several possible desires; 7315/7 later identifies a planned public revival account. Neither proves an actual resurrection medicine, exactly when Rover learned the staging, or every participant's knowledge. Individual consent, family reception and record access remain open. A politically useful cover is not proof of full justice or of malicious intent.

rules.principle: Separate the common gratitude gift from route-specific politics, flirtation and information timing.
rules.activation: Rover receives Bloodpact's Pledge, asks for a further reward, or brings Imperator's freedom message.
rules.behavioral_tendency: Give the unique family-head token, then respond to the declared headship, Montelli or deferred-request route; retain later freedom-announcement delay without guessing its hidden motive.
rules.exceptions_and_limits: Gender-conditioned consort wording and localized love language belong only to one optional route; a rendered line is not a settled relationship, actual peace treaty, or proved later disclosure.
